note: 25 novel queries for C2-V7/C2-V8 (Appendix 2.2, C2 Deliverable 7). Novel relative to phase_b.json/phase_c1.json (no text overlap) so cache-cold vs cache-warm (C2-V8) is a genuine test. expected_row_count is null until verified against a live run and frozen -- do not adjust the fixture to match output (same discipline as phase_b.json). >= 8 requires_join=true, >= 4 requires_shape_hypothesis=true (met: 13 and 8 respectively).

queries.text: Which sellers have never had a dispute raised against their orders?
queries.ground_truth_sql: SELECT s.seller_id, s.display_name FROM sellers s WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o JOIN disputes d ON d.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.seller_id = s.seller_id) ORDER BY s.seller_id

queries.text: What is the total order value per logistics provider?
queries.ground_truth_sql: SELECT lp.provider_id, lp.display_name, SUM(o.order_value) AS total_order_value FROM logistics_providers lp JOIN fulfillments f ON f.provider_id = lp.provider_id JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = f.order_id GROUP BY lp.provider_id, lp.display_name ORDER BY total_order_value DESC

queries.text: List fulfillments that are still pending with no delivery events recorded.
queries.ground_truth_sql: SELECT f.fulfillment_id, f.order_id FROM fulfillments f WHERE f.status = 'pending' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM delivery_events de WHERE de.fulfillment_id = f.fulfillment_id) ORDER BY f.fulfillment_id
queries.notes: status is CHECK-constrained lowercase ('pending'); absence-of-row pattern, not a nullable column.

queries.text: Which cities have both a seller and a logistics provider hub located in them?
queries.ground_truth_sql: SELECT DISTINCT l.city FROM locations l WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sellers s WHERE s.location_id = l.location_id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM logistics_providers lp WHERE lp.hub_location_id = l.location_id) ORDER BY l.city

queries.text: What is the average order value for B2B orders versus B2C orders?
queries.ground_truth_sql: SELECT order_channel, AVG(order_value) AS avg_order_value FROM orders GROUP BY order_channel ORDER BY order_channel
queries.notes: order_channel is CHECK-constrained lowercase ('b2b','b2c'); must not filter on 'B2B'/'B2C'.

queries.text: How many disputes remain unresolved, with no resolution date?
queries.ground_truth_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS unresolved_count FROM disputes WHERE resolved_at IS NULL
queries.notes: resolved_at is nullable; NULL means unresolved, not a missing/invalid value.

queries.text: List the top 3 sellers by total number of distinct catalog items sold.
queries.ground_truth_sql: SELECT s.seller_id, s.display_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ci.item_id) AS distinct_items FROM sellers s JOIN catalog_items ci ON ci.seller_id = s.seller_id GROUP BY s.seller_id, s.display_name ORDER BY distinct_items DESC LIMIT 3

queries.text: What percentage of fulfillments were delivered after their promised time?
queries.ground_truth_sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE delivered_at IS NOT NULL AND delivered_at > promised_at) / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE delivered_at IS NOT NULL), 0), 2) AS pct_late FROM fulfillments
queries.notes: delivered_at nullable (NULL = not yet delivered, must be excluded from the denominator, not counted as on-time or late).

queries.text: Which buyer apps have placed orders totalling more than 10000 in value?
queries.ground_truth_sql: SELECT np.participant_id, np.legal_name, SUM(o.order_value) AS total_value FROM network_participants np JOIN orders o ON o.buyer_app_id = np.participant_id GROUP BY np.participant_id, np.legal_name HAVING SUM(o.order_value) > 10000 ORDER BY total_value DESC

queries.text: List sellers whose contracted SLA hours has not been set.
queries.ground_truth_sql: SELECT seller_id, display_name FROM sellers WHERE contracted_sla_hours IS NULL ORDER BY seller_id

queries.text: What is the total number of delivery events per event type?
queries.ground_truth_sql: SELECT event_type, COUNT(*) AS event_count FROM delivery_events GROUP BY event_type ORDER BY event_count DESC

queries.text: Which fulfillments required more than one delivery attempt?
queries.ground_truth_sql: SELECT fulfillment_id, order_id, attempt_count FROM fulfillments WHERE attempt_count > 1 ORDER BY attempt_count DESC

queries.text: List the 5 most recent disputes along with the seller name on the related order.
queries.ground_truth_sql: SELECT d.dispute_id, d.raised_at, s.display_name FROM disputes d JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = d.order_id JOIN sellers s ON s.seller_id = o.seller_id ORDER BY d.raised_at DESC LIMIT 5

queries.text: How many orders did each buyer app place through the b2b channel?
queries.ground_truth_sql: SELECT np.participant_id, np.legal_name, COUNT(*) AS b2b_order_count FROM network_participants np JOIN orders o ON o.buyer_app_id = np.participant_id WHERE o.order_channel = 'b2b' GROUP BY np.participant_id, np.legal_name ORDER BY b2b_order_count DESC
queries.notes: Join plus the same order_channel casing hypothesis as c2g_05.

queries.text: Which sellers have a Devanagari display name recorded?
queries.ground_truth_sql: SELECT seller_id, display_name, display_name_local FROM sellers WHERE display_name_local IS NOT NULL ORDER BY seller_id
queries.notes: display_name_local is nullable; only some seed rows populate it.

queries.text: What is the average number of hours between order placement and the fulfillment promise time?
queries.ground_truth_sql: SELECT AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (f.promised_at - o.placed_at)) / 3600.0) AS avg_hours FROM orders o JOIN fulfillments f ON f.order_id = o.order_id

queries.text: List logistics providers that are not enabled for B2B.
queries.ground_truth_sql: SELECT provider_id, display_name FROM logistics_providers WHERE b2b_enabled = false ORDER BY provider_id

queries.text: Which order line items have a quantity greater than 5?
queries.ground_truth_sql: SELECT order_id, item_id, quantity FROM order_items WHERE quantity > 5 ORDER BY quantity DESC

queries.text: What is the total dispute count broken down by category?
queries.ground_truth_sql: SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS dispute_count FROM disputes GROUP BY category ORDER BY dispute_count DESC

queries.text: List orders that have no associated dispute.
queries.ground_truth_sql: SELECT o.order_id FROM orders o WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM disputes d WHERE d.order_id = o.order_id) ORDER BY o.order_id LIMIT 1000
queries.notes: NOT EXISTS against disputes; most orders qualify, capped at max_rows_default.

queries.text: Which sellers are located in Maharashtra state?
queries.ground_truth_sql: SELECT s.seller_id, s.display_name FROM sellers s JOIN locations l ON l.location_id = s.location_id WHERE l.state = 'Maharashtra' ORDER BY s.seller_id

queries.text: What is the maximum order value ever recorded?
queries.ground_truth_sql: SELECT MAX(order_value) AS max_order_value FROM orders

queries.text: List logistics providers together with the city their hub is located in.
queries.ground_truth_sql: SELECT lp.provider_id, lp.display_name, l.city FROM logistics_providers lp JOIN locations l ON l.location_id = lp.hub_location_id ORDER BY lp.provider_id

queries.text: How many catalog items does each seller have priced above 1000?
queries.ground_truth_sql: SELECT s.seller_id, s.display_name, COUNT(*) AS item_count FROM sellers s JOIN catalog_items ci ON ci.seller_id = s.seller_id WHERE ci.unit_price > 1000 GROUP BY s.seller_id, s.display_name ORDER BY item_count DESC
queries.notes: sellers -> catalog_items with a price filter.

queries.text: Which delivery events are missing a location reference?
queries.ground_truth_sql: SELECT event_id, fulfillment_id, event_type FROM delivery_events WHERE location_id IS NULL ORDER BY event_id LIMIT 1000
